name: KEBIMO SA
note: Senegalese building and public-works (BTP) company based in Sacré-Cœur, Dakar; an official sponsor of ASC Ville de Dakar per its own site ('KEBIMO SA, SPONSOR OFFICIEL DE L'ASC VILLE DE DAKAR') and Le Journal de Dakar (13 Apr 2026: FCFA 10m for 2026 plus FCFA 10m for the BAL campaign, per club president Yatma Diaw; FCFA 40m in 2025). Its owner could not be documented from public sources — the company site names no owner, and its director general is Pape Mballo Kébé — so it stays unrated.
